title: An Unexpected Connection
content:
The following evening...

After thinking about it for a long time, Yagnesh finally made up his mind.

"An apology over a phone call won't feel sincere."

"Some things should be said face to face."

Taking a deep breath, he dialled Shreya's number.

The phone rang twice.

"Hello?"

Yagnesh suddenly became nervous.

His throat felt dry.

"H-Hello... Shreya."

"Yes?" she replied politely.

"Who is this?"

"I'm... Yagnesh."

"Sneha's friend."

There was a brief pause.

"Oh..."

"The one from the café this morning?"

"Yes."

"So... what's the matter?"

Yagnesh hesitated for a moment before speaking.

"If you don't mind..."

"Can we meet at the same café?"

"I'd like to talk to you."

Shreya smiled softly.

"Alright."

"I'll be there in a few minutes."

The call ended.

________________________________________

Nearly twenty minutes later...

Yagnesh reached the café.

He walked to the same table where he had first met Shreya and quietly took a seat.

His fingers tapped nervously against the coffee cup as he waited.

A few minutes later...

The café door opened.

Almost instinctively...

His eyes lifted.

For a brief moment...

Everything around him seemed to fade away.

A young woman walked gracefully toward him.

She wore a simple sky-blue dress that swayed gently with each step. Her hair moved softly in the evening breeze as she entered the café, and the warm lights reflected gently in her eyes. There was nothing overly glamorous about her appearance, yet there was a quiet elegance that made it impossible for Yagnesh to look away.

He found himself staring.

"Is... that really Shreya?"

She noticed him and smiled before walking straight toward his table.

"Good evening."

Yagnesh quickly stood up, realizing he had been staring.

"G-Good evening, Shreya."

"Please... have a seat."

She smiled politely and sat opposite him.

For a few moments...

Neither of them spoke.

Finally, Shreya broke the silence.

"So..."

"This morning you suddenly left."

"And now you've called me here."

"What happened?"

Yagnesh took a deep breath.

"I wanted to apologize."

Shreya looked at him quietly.

He continued,

"When I first saw you..."

"All I could think about was what happened to Siddu."

"I judged you because of your past without giving you a chance to show who you've become."

"That wasn't fair."

"I'm really sorry, Shreya."

For a few seconds...

She simply looked at him.

Then...

A gentle smile slowly appeared on her face.

Yagnesh unconsciously forgot everything else.

Her smile...

It was warm.

Peaceful.

Beautiful.

He couldn't take his eyes off her.

Shreya noticed his expression and laughed softly.

"Why are you looking at me like that?"

Yagnesh blinked and immediately looked away.

"N-Nothing."

"I was just..."

He couldn't even finish his sentence.

Shreya smiled once again.

"You know..."

"You're the first person who's ever apologized after hurting me."

"Most people decide who I am..."

"And never bother to know who I've become."

"So..."

"Thank you."

There was no bitterness in her voice.

Only quiet gratitude.

Before Yagnesh could reply...

Her phone vibrated.

"Excuse me."

She picked it up to check the message.

As she placed the phone on the table...

Yagnesh's eyes suddenly widened.

"Wait..."

"Is that...?"

He leaned forward excitedly.

"You watch anime?"

Shreya looked at her phone cover and smiled.

"Oh..."

"This?"

"Yeah."

"I love anime."

Yagnesh's face instantly lit up.

"Seriously?"

"I'm a die-hard anime fan!"

Shreya tilted her head playfully.

"I can see that."

"But why are you suddenly so excited?"

Without thinking...

The words slipped out of his mouth.

"It's different when the person you like watches anime too."

The moment the sentence left his lips...

Time seemed to stop.

Both of them froze.

Yagnesh's eyes widened in horror.

"What did I just say?"

His face instantly turned bright red.

"I-I mean..."

"N-No..."

"I wasn't trying to say..."

He stumbled over every word, unable to form a proper sentence.

Shreya looked at him for a second.

Then...

She couldn't hold it in anymore.

A soft laugh escaped her lips.

Seeing her laugh...

Yagnesh could only lower his head in complete embarrassment.

For the first time in many years...

Shreya laughed without carrying the weight of her past.

And as Yagnesh watched her smile...

He unknowingly took the first step toward becoming a new chapter in her life.
